title: Case 035: Merchant has received the return but the refund review has not started

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The merchant warehouse has a receipt but the authorised refunds team has no review case. The next action is to submit that receipt to start review.
initial_request: The warehouse says it has my return, but my order has no refund review. Please pass the receipt to the team that handles it.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Send the receipt reference to the merchant's authorised refunds team.

outcome: The team confirms the review is registered and provides its next update date; payment is not claimed.
boundaries: Registered review is not an approved refund or money received.

events.body: Inline receipt WH-035: RT-035 for TG-035 physically received at 08:10 UTC today. We can confirm receipt, but our receiving role does not approve refunds.
The warehouse says it has my return, but my order has no refund review. Please pass the receipt to the team that handles it.
Please register the refund review for TG-035 / RT-035 using warehouse receipt WH-035. Notify us of the case reference and next update date; receipt alone is not refund approval.
Review RF-035 is registered with WH-035. We will update the order thread by 2026-03-10, 16:00 UTC. Eligibility, amount and payment remain undecided.
